name: Zephyr Yield Share
oneLiner: ZYS is Zephyr Protocol's yield-share wrapper over ZSD, with its NAV moving as protocol yield accrues into the underlying ZSD yield reserve.
collateral: ZSD held in the Zephyr Protocol yield reserve; each ZYS share represents a claim on the protocol's ZSD yield reserve balance
pegMechanism: ZYS is a NAV-style yield-share token rather than a flat one-dollar stablecoin. Its share price moves against ZSD as protocol yield accrues into the ZSD yield reserve.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Zephyr documentation presents ZYS as a protocol-native asset on the same Monero-derived chain as ZSD and does not identify an issuer-controlled freeze, blacklist, pause, privileged burn, or proxy-upgrade control surface for holder balances.

reserves.name: ZSD yield reserve backing ZYS shares

notices.title: Native private-chain yield share
notices.message: ZYS is tracked as Zephyr's yield-share wrapper over ZSD, not as base ZSD itself. Pharos sources supply, price, and APY from Zephyr Scanner because CoinGecko and DefiLlama do not expose this wrapper.
